name: Devotion
overview: Scripture teaches that true devotion involves sincere service to God alone, as one cannot serve two masters without conflict (Luke 16:13). Genuine acts of righteousness and giving should be done discreetly, seeking the reward from the Father rather than human approval (Matthew 6:1; Acts 20:35). Believers are encouraged to support one another in faith without judgment (Romans 14:1), and to maintain a steadfast trust in God, using faith as a shield against spiritual challenges (Ephesians 6:16). A devotion shaped by focusing on virtues such as truth, purity, and goodness reflects a Christ-centered mindset (Philippians 4:8).
